newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Oct trade gap expected over $1 bln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Oct trade gap expected over $1 bln - paper.

text.p: Brazilian government officials expect the trade deficit to exceed $1 billion in October and reach $3.5 billion to $4 billion in the whole of 1996, a newspaper said.
The government's economic team does not see a recovery in the trade balance before the second quarter of 1997, O Globo said.
Imports are expected to continue growing while exports will not increase sufficiently at around 3.8 percent to offset imports, O Globo said.
Last week, the government revealed disappointing exports of $4.188 billion in October, up from $4.115 billion in September but down from October 1995's $4.405 billion.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
